statusNote: VISUAL_PARITY_PENDING (Gate 30, PORTAL-NEXT-03): implementation exists, visual comparison against an Approved Reference not yet passed. Distinct from PARITY_PENDING, which is about functional/data parity. A module moves VISUAL_PARITY_PENDING -> UAT_PENDING only after its structural/visual comparison test suite actually passes — never skipped, never auto-promoted to HUMAN_APPROVED regardless of technical PASS (only a human can do that).
note: functionalSource points at the REAL V1 location identified during PORTAL-NEXT-01's audit. Nothing at those paths was read, imported, or ported this phase — see tests/business-logic-scanner.py. approvedReference ids are design-system-2.1 approvedReferences[] ids, resolved not copied — see tests/foundation-regression.py's reference-resolution check.
